experts.name: ex_wordstart
experts.purpose: first letter of a new word after a space

experts.name: ex_inword_short
experts.purpose: second/third letter of a word (1-2 letters so far)

experts.name: ex_inword_long
experts.purpose: letters after the third of a word, word ends, suffixes

experts.name: ex_quote
experts.purpose: token after a double quote (open or close)

router.purpose: hard class of prev token + word length, top-1 dispatch

circuits.name: cl_router
circuits.purpose: Score 7 experts from the class of prev and current word length

circuits.name: cl_qstate
circuits.purpose: Toggle inside-quote flag on each double-quote token

circuits.name: cl_trigram
circuits.purpose: Additive letter-pair corrections for ~40 common pairs (th, ng, ed, ...)

circuits.name: cl_words_fn
circuits.purpose: Word-completion trie for ~80 function words (the, and, was, ...)

circuits.name: cl_words_open
circuits.purpose: Word-completion trie for ~170 content words and names

circuits.name: cl_suffix
circuits.purpose: Word-end evidence from suffixes (ing, ed, ly, ful, s, er, y ...)

circuits.name: cl_wordstart
circuits.purpose: First-letter evidence keyed on previous word / sentence-comma context

circuits.name: cl_colloc
circuits.purpose: Multi-word phrase 8-gram evidence (once upon a time, wanted to, ...)

circuits.name: cl_endpunct
circuits.purpose: Comma/period/!/? evidence after a word, quote-aware

circuits.name: cl_quote
circuits.purpose: Opening/closing quote and in-quote punctuation dynamics

circuits.name: cl_apos
circuits.purpose: Apostrophe and contraction evidence (didn't, i'm, tom's)

circuits.name: cl_name_write
circuits.purpose: Capture letters of the word after 'named ' into the name-cache state

circuits.name: cl_name_read
circuits.purpose: Boost letters continuing the cached protagonist name

state.meaning: state[0] = inside-quote flag q (updated by cl_qstate at root); state[1:225] = name cache nm (buffer 6x36, cap flag, one-hot length; updated by cl_name_write at root). Both updates are shared-trunk clusters at the root, computed before routing so experts see flags already updated for prev.
